message: Hi Alex, it's Dev at Polar HVAC, nice. Can you also build me a mobile app for bookings and run my Facebook ads while you are at it? Same price?
reply: Hey Dev, thanks for the reply! To be upfront: we only do website fixes, not apps or ad management. The $900 fix pack covers your website issues only, same price either way. We can't guarantee results, but we'll audit and clean things up properly. Happy to point you to folks who do apps/ads if useful. Want me to send the audit findings first?
